title: 碎片大廈
summary: 碎片大廈由 Renzo Piano 設計、WSP 擔任結構設計、Mace 承建，官方高度 309.6 m、共 95 層。結構依用途分區：下部辦公層為複合鋼構，上部飯店與住宅層為 200 mm 後拉預力混凝土平板，塔頂以鋼構「散熱器」與桅桿收尾；中央混凝土核心筒是主要抗側骨幹，以費氏桁架與 A 形轉換調整柱距。英國首次採用由上而下的核心筒施工，讓核心筒在地下室開挖時同步上升。本課涵蓋分區質量、扭轉、預力樓板、轉換構件、由上而下施工、尖塔與塔吊、風洞、鄰近鐵路監測、帷幕牆與帽桁架的交接。
summaryEn: The Shard, designed by Renzo Piano with WSP as structural designer and Mace as contractor, is officially 309.6 m tall with 95 storeys. Its structure is zoned by use: composite steel for the lower offices, 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs for the hotel and homes above, and a steel radiator and mast at the crown; a central concrete core is the main lateral spine, with Vierendeel trusses and A-frames changing column spacing. It was the first UK use of top-down core construction, letting the core rise while the basement was being dug. The course covers zoned mass, torsion, post-tensioned slabs, transfer structures, top-down construction, spire and cranes, wind-tunnel testing, monitoring of adjacent rail assets, curtain-wall joints and the handover of hat trusses.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：由允許擺幅反推核心筒所需勁度與牆厚。以等效均布風荷載 w = 60 kN/m 作用於 H = 306 m 的懸臂，頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。若容許 Δ = 0.40 m，需 EI = wH⁴/(8Δ) = 60×306⁴/(8×0.40) ≈ 1.64×10¹¹ kN·m²；取混凝土 E = 40 GPa，I = 1.64×10¹¹/(4.0×10⁷) ≈ 4,110 m⁴。以邊長 b = 20 m 的薄壁方形核心 I ≈ (2/3)t·b³ 估算，t = 4,110/((2/3)×8,000) ≈ 0.77 m。若改要求 Δ = 0.30 m，EI 增為約 2.19×10¹¹ kN·m²，I ≈ 5,480 m⁴，t ≈ 1.03 m，牆厚增加約三分之一；若改以外伸帽桁架提供部分勁度，則可在不加厚牆的情況下達到相同變位。數值為教學假設，未計開口、翼牆、背包次核心與動力效應，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: back-calculate core stiffness and wall thickness from the allowed sway. Apply an equivalent uniform wind load w = 60 kN/m to a cantilever H = 306 m tall, with top drift Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). For an allowed Δ = 0.40 m, EI = wH⁴/(8Δ) = 60×306⁴/(8×0.40) ≈ 1.64×10¹¹ kN·m²; with E = 40 GPa, I = 1.64×10¹¹/(4.0×10⁷) ≈ 4,110 m⁴. For a thin-walled square core of side b = 20 m, I ≈ (2/3)t·b³, so t = 4,110/((2/3)×8,000) ≈ 0.77 m. Tightening the limit to Δ = 0.30 m raises EI to about 2.19×10¹¹ kN·m², I ≈ 5,480 m⁴ and t ≈ 1.03 m, about a third thicker; letting outrigger hat trusses supply part of the stiffness reaches the same drift without thickening the walls. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring openings, wing walls, the Backpack core and dynamic effects, not the actual design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「混合用途分區與樓板系統」與「核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" and "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「用途分區與樓板質量」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Use zoning and floor mass” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計者公開說明：下部辦公與零售層採複合鋼構，周邊到混凝土核心筒的跨度可達約 15 m，樓板梁為約 500 mm 深的組合斷面；上部飯店與住宅層改用 200 mm 厚後拉預力混凝土平板，跨度約 9 m、層高約 3.1 m；塔頂約 60 m 為鋼構「散熱器」，容納散熱設備並圍繞中央斜撐鋼桅。上部較重的混凝土樓板增加了高處的模態質量與阻尼，設計者因此認為不需要另設補充阻尼裝置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「用途分區與樓板質量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The designers explain that the lower office and retail floors are composite steel with spans of up to about 15 m from the perimeter to the concrete core and built-up floor beams about 500 mm deep; the hotel and residential floors above switch to 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs spanning about 9 m with a storey height of about 3.1 m; the top 60 m or so is a steel radiator housing heat-rejection plant around a central braced steel mast. The heavier concrete floors high up add modal mass and damping, which the designers considered sufficient to avoid supplementary damping devices. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Use zoning and floor mass” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa；複合樓板等效厚 0.11 m×24 kN/m³ + 鋼梁 0.5 kPa ≈ 3.1 kPa，約 1.6 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「用途分區與樓板質量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Use zoning and floor mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「用途分區與樓板質量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Use zoning and floor mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa；複合樓板等效厚 0.11 m×24 kN/m³ + 鋼梁 0.5 kPa ≈ 3.1 kPa，約 1.6 倍。若上部樓板使第一模態廣義質量增加 20%，在相同風力與阻尼下共振加速度約降為 1/1.2 ≈ 83%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier. If the upper floors raise the first-mode generalised mass by 20%, resonant acceleration under the same wind force and damping falls to about 1/1.2 ≈ 83%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較；完工後以環境振動量測頻率與阻尼，確認無補充阻尼的假設成立。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests; after completion measure frequency and damping by ambient vibration to confirm that the no-supplementary-damping assumption holds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「用途分區與樓板質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Use zoning and floor mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較；完工後以環境振動量測頻率與阻尼，確認無補充阻尼的假設成立。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests; after completion measure frequency and damping by ambient vibration to confirm that the no-supplementary-damping assumption holds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準應記錄各分區的樓板質量假設與其對加速度的影響，日後若變更用途（例如住宅改辦公）或大幅減輕裝修，須由結構工程師評估居住性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should record the floor-mass assumption of each zone and its effect on acceleration, and any later change of use, such as residential to office, or major lightening of finishes requires the structural engineer to reassess habitability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較；完工後以環境振動量測頻率與阻尼，確認無補充阻尼的假設成立。
knowledge.textEn: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests; after completion measure frequency and damping by ambient vibration to confirm that the no-supplementary-damping assumption holds.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計基準應記錄各分區的樓板質量假設與其對加速度的影響，日後若變更用途（例如住宅改辦公）或大幅減輕裝修，須由結構工程師評估居住性。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should record the floor-mass assumption of each zone and its effect on acceleration, and any later change of use, such as residential to office, or major lightening of finishes requires the structural engineer to reassess habitability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「混合用途分區與樓板系統」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems"?
options: 在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。
optionsEn: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets.
quiz.explanation: 在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較；完工後以環境振動量測頻率與阻尼，確認無補充阻尼的假設成立。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests; after completion measure frequency and damping by ambient vibration to confirm that the no-supplementary-damping assumption holds. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「用途分區與樓板質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Use zoning and floor mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：上部較重的混凝土樓板增加了高處的模態質量與阻尼，設計者因此認為不需要另設補充阻尼裝置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The heavier concrete floors high up add modal mass and damping, which the designers considered sufficient to avoid supplementary damping devices.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混合用途分區與樓板系統」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上。
只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits.
If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem.

quiz.explanationEn: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「背包次核心與扭轉」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backpack secondary core and torsion” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。塔樓低層一側附有被稱為「背包」的低層附屬量體，其中設有次核心，用來減少主核心承受的扭轉。當風力合力或質量中心與剛心不重合時，樓層會繞剛心旋轉，角落位移比中心大；在偏心側增加剪力牆，相當於增大扭轉勁度並拉近剛心與質心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「背包次核心與扭轉」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability. A low-rise annex called the Backpack attaches to one side at the lower levels, and its secondary core reduces torsion on the main core. When the wind resultant or centre of mass does not coincide with the centre of stiffness, floors rotate about the stiffness centre and corners move more than the middle; adding shear walls on the eccentric side raises torsional stiffness and draws the centres together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Backpack secondary core and torsion” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「背包次核心與扭轉」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Backpack secondary core and torsion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉
knowledge.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core
knowledge.text: 中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。塔樓低層一側附有被稱為「背包」的低層附屬量體，其中設有次核心，用來減少主核心承受的扭轉。
knowledge.textEn: The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability. A low-rise annex called the Backpack attaches to one side at the lower levels, and its secondary core reduces torsion on the main core.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core" is correct?
options: 只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。
後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。
中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。
optionsEn: If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem.
A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete.

The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability.
quiz.explanation: 中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背包次核心與扭轉」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backpack secondary core and torsion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。F = 20,000 kN、偏心 e = 5 m，T = 100,000 kN·m；主核心 K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad 時 θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad，r = 30 m 的角落位移 15 mm；次核心使 K_T 增為 2.5×10⁸，θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad，角落位移 12 mm，減少 20%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r. With F = 20,000 kN and e = 5 m, T = 100,000 kN·m; a main-core K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad gives θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 15 mm at a corner r = 30 m away; a secondary core raising K_T to 2.5×10⁸ gives θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 12 mm, 20% less. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維模型計算各層質心與剛心的偏心距、扭轉模態週期與參與質量，比較有無次核心的角落位移；風洞試驗需提供扭矩頻譜，確認角落加速度在居住性準則內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the three-dimensional model to compute the eccentricity between centres of mass and stiffness at each level, torsional periods and participating mass, comparing corner displacements with and without the secondary core; the wind-tunnel test must supply torque spectra to confirm corner accelerations meet habitability criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。F = 20,000 kN、偏心 e = 5 m，T = 100,000 kN·m；主核心 K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad 時 θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad，r = 30 m 的角落位移 15 mm；次核心使 K_T 增為 2.5×10⁸，θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad，角落位移 12 mm，減少 20%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r. With F = 20,000 kN and e = 5 m, T = 100,000 kN·m; a main-core K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad gives θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 15 mm at a corner r = 30 m away; a secondary core raising K_T to 2.5×10⁸ gives θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 12 mm, 20% less. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core", which statement holds?
options: 扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。
由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。
大樓擺動 300 至 400 mm 就表示結構有安全疑慮。
optionsEn: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r.
Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design.
A tower swaying 300 to 400 mm means it is structurally unsafe.
quiz.explanation: 扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背包次核心與扭轉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backpack secondary core and torsion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維模型計算各層質心與剛心的偏心距、扭轉模態週期與參與質量，比較有無次核心的角落位移；風洞試驗需提供扭矩頻譜，確認角落加速度在居住性準則內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the three-dimensional model to compute the eccentricity between centres of mass and stiffness at each level, torsional periods and participating mass, comparing corner displacements with and without the secondary core; the wind-tunnel test must supply torque spectra to confirm corner accelerations meet habitability criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對有附屬量體或不對稱收分的塔樓，設計報告應逐層列出偏心距與扭轉不規則判定，並說明次核心或翼牆的配置理由；施工中次核心與主核心的連接樓板須按順序完成。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For towers with annexes or asymmetric tapering, the design report should list eccentricity and torsional-irregularity checks floor by floor and justify the secondary core or wing walls; floors linking secondary and main cores must be completed in the planned sequence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若忽略低層附屬量體造成的偏心，主核心牆角落與連梁會在風下承受額外剪力與扭轉應力而開裂；角落帷幕牆的層間變位也會大於設計值，造成密封失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring the eccentricity created by a low-rise annex loads the corners and coupling beams of the main core with extra shear and torsional stress that can crack them, and corner curtain walls see larger inter-storey movements than designed, causing seal failures. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以三維模型計算各層質心與剛心的偏心距、扭轉模態週期與參與質量，比較有無次核心的角落位移；風洞試驗需提供扭矩頻譜，確認角落加速度在居住性準則內。
knowledge.textEn: Use the three-dimensional model to compute the eccentricity between centres of mass and stiffness at each level, torsional periods and participating mass, comparing corner displacements with and without the secondary core; the wind-tunnel test must supply torque spectra to confirm corner accelerations meet habitability criteria.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對有附屬量體或不對稱收分的塔樓，設計報告應逐層列出偏心距與扭轉不規則判定，並說明次核心或翼牆的配置理由；施工中次核心與主核心的連接樓板須按順序完成。

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背包次核心與扭轉」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backpack secondary core and torsion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若忽略低層附屬量體造成的偏心，主核心牆角落與連梁會在風下承受額外剪力與扭轉應力而開裂；角落帷幕牆的層間變位也會大於設計值，造成密封失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the eccentricity created by a low-rise annex loads the corners and coupling beams of the main core with extra shear and torsional stress that can crack them, and corner curtain walls see larger inter-storey movements than designed, causing seal failures. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：當風力合力或質量中心與剛心不重合時，樓層會繞剛心旋轉，角落位移比中心大；在偏心側增加剪力牆，相當於增大扭轉勁度並拉近剛心與質心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When the wind resultant or centre of mass does not coincide with the centre of stiffness, floors rotate about the stiffness centre and corners move more than the middle; adding shear walls on the eccentric side raises torsional stiffness and draws the centres together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱」與「柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns" and "Column-spacing transfers by Vierendeel trusses and A-frames": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「200 mm 後拉預力平板」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 上部飯店與住宅層的柱使用約 65 至 80 MPa 高強混凝土，樓板為 50 至 60 MPa 的後拉預力平板。後拉鋼腱以拋物線佈置，在跨中靠下、在柱上靠上，張拉後對混凝土產生向上的等效荷重，抵銷大部分自重；薄板因此能以約 9 m 跨度、200 mm 厚度控制撓度與裂縫，縮小層高並在塔頂收分時節省高度。柱斷面因高強度而縮小，讓逐層收縮的平面仍保有可用面積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「200 mm 後拉預力平板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Columns in the upper hotel and residential levels use about 65 to 80 MPa high-strength concrete, and floors are 50 to 60 MPa post-tensioned flat slabs. Tendons follow a parabolic profile, low at mid-span and high over columns, so after stressing they apply an upward equivalent load that cancels most of the self-weight; the thin slab can therefore span about 9 m at 200 mm thick while controlling deflection and cracking, reducing storey height and saving height as the tower tapers. High strength keeps column sections small so the shrinking floor plates retain usable area. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平衡荷重 w_bal = 8Pe/L²，故 P = w_bal·L²/(8e)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The balanced load is w_bal = 8Pe/L², so P = w_bal·L²/(8e).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「200 mm 後拉預力平板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns" is correct?
options: 上部飯店與住宅層的柱使用約 65 至 80 MPa 高強混凝土，樓板為 50 至 60 MPa 的後拉預力平板。

steps.title: 後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「200 mm 後拉預力平板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平衡荷重 w_bal = 8Pe/L²，故 P = w_bal·L²/(8e)。目標平衡 3.5 kPa（約自重 70%）、L = 9 m、垂度 e = 0.06 m：P = 3.5×81/(8×0.06) ≈ 591 kN/m；對 200 mm 板平均預壓 591/0.2 ≈ 2.95 MPa；跨深比 9,000/200 = 45。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The balanced load is w_bal = 8Pe/L², so P = w_bal·L²/(8e). Balancing 3.5 kPa, about 70% of self-weight, over L = 9 m with a drape e = 0.06 m needs P = 3.5×81/(8×0.06) ≈ 591 kN/m, an average precompression of 591/0.2 ≈ 2.95 MPa in a 200 mm slab; the span-to-depth ratio is 9,000/200 = 45. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：張拉前確認混凝土達到規定的轉移強度（以現場養護試體或成熟度判定），張拉時同時記錄千斤頂力與伸長量並與計算值比較（例如允差 ±7%）；拆模後量測樓板撓度，與含預力損失的預測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before stressing, confirm the concrete has reached the specified transfer strength from field-cured specimens or maturity; during stressing record jack force and elongation together and compare with calculation, for example within ±7%; after striking, measure slab deflection against predictions that include prestress losses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 平衡荷重 w_bal = 8Pe/L²，故 P = w_bal·L²/(8e)。目標平衡 3.5 kPa（約自重 70%）、L = 9 m、垂度 e = 0.06 m：P = 3.5×81/(8×0.06) ≈ 591 kN/m；對 200 mm 板平均預壓 591/0.2 ≈ 2.95 MPa；跨深比 9,000/200 = 45。數值為教學假設。

Balancing 3.5 kPa, about 70% of self-weight, over L = 9 m with a drape e = 0.06 m needs P = 3.5×81/(8×0.06) ≈ 591 kN/m, an average precompression of 591/0.2 ≈ 2.95 MPa in a 200 mm slab; the span-to-depth ratio is 9,000/200 = 45. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns", which statement holds?
options: 塔吊的荷重只由塔吊自身的基礎承擔，與主結構無關。
平衡荷重 w_bal = 8Pe/L²，故 P = w_bal·L²/(8e)。
只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。
optionsEn: A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure.
The balanced load is w_bal = 8Pe/L², so P = w_bal·L²/(8e).
If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets.
quiz.explanation: 平衡荷重 w_bal = 8Pe/L²，故 P = w_bal·L²/(8e)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The balanced load is w_bal = 8Pe/L², so P = w_bal·L²/(8e). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「200 mm 後拉預力平板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 張拉前確認混凝土達到規定的轉移強度（以現場養護試體或成熟度判定），張拉時同時記錄千斤頂力與伸長量並與計算值比較（例如允差 ±7%）；拆模後量測樓板撓度，與含預力損失的預測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before stressing, confirm the concrete has reached the specified transfer strength from field-cured specimens or maturity; during stressing record jack force and elongation together and compare with calculation, for example within ±7%; after striking, measure slab deflection against predictions that include prestress losses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預力樓板竣工圖必須標示鋼腱位置與禁鑽區，物業管理規章規定任何鑽孔須先以掃描定位並經結構工程師核可；張拉屬高風險作業，須由合格專業廠商依核准程序執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: As-built drawings of post-tensioned slabs must show tendon locations and no-drill zones, building rules must require scanning and structural approval before any drilling, and stressing, a high-risk operation, must be done by a qualified specialist under an approved procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：日後在預力板上鑽孔或切割若打斷鋼腱，會突然失去預力，造成局部撓度增加，甚至鋼腱彈出的危險；張拉時混凝土強度不足則可能使錨定區爆裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Drilling or cutting a post-tensioned slab later and severing a tendon causes a sudden loss of prestress, extra local deflection and even the danger of a tendon ejecting; stressing before the concrete is strong enough can burst the anchorage zone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.objective: 說明「費氏桁架與 A 形轉換」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。

steps.instruction: 不同用途要求不同柱距：辦公需要開闊空間，住宅與飯店則以房間模組配置柱位。設計者以鋼構費氏桁架把上部柱重新對位到辦公層，並以費氏格框把周邊柱距由 6 m 逐步加密到 3 m 再到 1.5 m；在與背包量體交接處則用 A 形轉換構架加大下方柱距。核心內另有轉換牆與轉換梁支撐半高處的空中大廳。重新對位的傾斜周邊柱會在樓板隔板產生推拉水平力，最後由核心筒平衡。費氏桁架沒有斜桿，靠弦桿與豎桿的剛接彎矩傳遞剪力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「費氏桁架與 A 形轉換」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different uses need different column spacing: offices want open space while homes and hotels align columns with room modules. The designers used steel Vierendeel trusses to realign upper columns onto the office floors, and Vierendeel grids to step perimeter column spacing from 6 m to 3 m to 1.5 m; at the junction with the Backpack, A-frame transfers widen the spacing below. Inside the core, transfer walls and girders support the mid-height sky lobby. Inclined perimeter columns that realign create push–pull forces in the floor diaphragms, finally resolved by the core. A Vierendeel truss has no diagonals and carries shear through bending in rigidly connected chords and verticals. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Vierendeel and A-frame transfers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In a Vierendeel panel the two chords share the shear equally with contraflexure at mid-panel, so the chord end moment is M = (V/2)(a/2).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沒有斜桿的費氏桁架承載力和有斜桿的桁架差不多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「費氏桁架與 A 形轉換」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vierendeel and A-frame transfers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：費氏桁架每格剪力由上下弦桿平分，反曲點在格中，弦桿端彎矩 M = (V/2)(a/2)。格內剪力 V = 1,200 kN、格寬 a = 3.0 m：M = 600×1.5 = 900 kN·m；若格寬改為 1.5 m，M 降為 450 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In a Vierendeel panel the two chords share the shear equally with contraflexure at mid-panel, so the chord end moment is M = (V/2)(a/2). For a panel shear V = 1,200 kN and width a = 3.0 m, M = 600×1.5 = 900 kN·m; halving the width to 1.5 m reduces M to 450 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以考慮施工順序的模型計算轉換構件在各階段的內力與撓度，確認上方樓層澆置或安裝時轉換構件已完成並具足夠勁度；剛接節點的全滲透焊依規範做超音波檢測，並量測轉換層的實際撓度與預拱值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a sequence-aware model to compute transfer-member forces and deflections at each stage, confirming the transfers are complete and stiff enough before floors above are cast or erected; ultrasonically test the complete-penetration welds at rigid joints to the code and compare the measured deflection of transfer levels with the camber provided.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以考慮施工順序的模型計算轉換構件在各階段的內力與撓度，確認上方樓層澆置或安裝時轉換構件已完成並具足夠勁度；剛接節點的全滲透焊依規範做超音波檢測，並量測轉換層的實際撓度與預拱值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a sequence-aware model to compute transfer-member forces and deflections at each stage, confirming the transfers are complete and stiff enough before floors above are cast or erected; ultrasonically test the complete-penetration welds at rigid joints to the code and compare the measured deflection of transfer levels with the camber provided. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：轉換構件應列為關鍵構件，施工圖標示預拱、臨時支撐與允許拆撐的條件；轉換層樓板的開孔與日後改裝須經結構工程師審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat transfer members as key elements, showing camber, temporary shoring and conditions for removing it on the drawings, and require structural review for openings and later alterations in transfer-level slabs.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：費氏桁架節點若焊接品質不足或剛接性不夠，弦桿彎矩無法傳遞，轉換構件撓度與上部柱沉陷超出預期，造成上層樓板與隔間開裂；樓板隔板若在傾斜柱處被開孔削弱，推拉力找不到路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If Vierendeel joints are poorly welded or not rigid enough, chord moments cannot transfer, so transfer deflection and settlement of columns above exceed predictions and crack upper floors and partitions; diaphragms weakened by openings at inclined columns leave push–pull forces without a path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「費氏桁架與 A 形轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 費氏桁架節點若焊接品質不足或剛接性不夠，弦桿彎矩無法傳遞，轉換構件撓度與上部柱沉陷超出預期，造成上層樓板與隔間開裂；樓板隔板若在傾斜柱處被開孔削弱，推拉力找不到路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If Vierendeel joints are poorly welded or not rigid enough, chord moments cannot transfer, so transfer deflection and settlement of columns above exceed predictions and crack upper floors and partitions; diaphragms weakened by openings at inclined columns leave push–pull forces without a path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步」與「爬升塔吊與塔頂尖塔施工」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug" and "Climbing cranes and spire construction": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「由上而下的核心筒」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Top-down core” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主塔地下室採由上而下施工：先施作周邊直徑 900 mm 的咬合樁擋土牆與直徑 1,500 mm、深約 50 m 的鑽掘樁，在樁中插入鋼柱（插入柱），再由地面向下逐層施作樓板並開挖，樓板同時作為擋土牆的水平支撐。核心筒則在地下室尚未完成時就開始向上施作，地上與地下同時推進。這縮短工期並限制鄰近地層位移，但在筏基完成前，核心筒與已完成樓層的荷重全靠插入柱與樁承擔，因此可以先蓋多高是一個明確的計算問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「由上而下的核心筒」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main tower basement was built top-down: first a perimeter secant-pile wall of 900 mm piles and 1,500 mm bored piles about 50 m deep were installed, with steel plunge columns set into the piles; then slabs were cast level by level downward as excavation proceeded, each slab propping the retaining wall. The core started rising before the basement was finished, so work advanced above and below ground at once. This shortens the programme and limits ground movement, but until the raft is complete the core and finished floors rely entirely on the plunge columns and piles, so how high the core may go first is an explicit calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Top-down core” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：倫敦黏土中鑽掘樁側摩擦 Q_s = πDLαc_u。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Side friction of a bored pile in London Clay is Q_s = πDLαc_u.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「由上而下的核心筒」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Top-down core”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步
knowledge.titleEn: Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug
knowledge.text: 主塔地下室採由上而下施工：先施作周邊直徑 900 mm 的咬合樁擋土牆與直徑 1,500 mm、深約 50 m 的鑽掘樁，在樁中插入鋼柱（插入柱），再由地面向下逐層施作樓板並開挖，樓板同時作為擋土牆的水平支撐。核心筒則在地下室尚未完成時就開始向上施作，地上與地下同時推進。
knowledge.textEn: The main tower basement was built top-down: first a perimeter secant-pile wall of 900 mm piles and 1,500 mm bored piles about 50 m deep were installed, with steel plunge columns set into the piles; then slabs were cast level by level downward as excavation proceeded, each slab propping the retaining wall. The core started rising before the basement was finished, so work advanced above and below ground at once.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「由上而下的核心筒」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Top-down core” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：倫敦黏土中鑽掘樁側摩擦 Q_s = πDLαc_u。D = 1.5 m、L = 50 m、α = 0.5、平均 c_u = 150 kPa：Q_s ≈ 17,670 kN，安全係數 2.5 得容許約 7,070 kN。若核心下方 8 支插入柱樁，核心每層荷重 3,000 kN，筏基完成前最多約 8×7,070/3,000 ≈ 18 層。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Side friction of a bored pile in London Clay is Q_s = πDLαc_u. With D = 1.5 m, L = 50 m, α = 0.5 and average c_u = 150 kPa, Q_s ≈ 17,670 kN, or about 7,070 kN allowable with a factor of safety of 2.5. With 8 plunge-column piles under the core and 3,000 kN of core load per storey, the core can rise at most about 8×7,070/3,000 ≈ 18 storeys before the raft is complete. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：插入柱的位置與垂直度在澆置前以測量確認（常見允差為長度的 1/400 以內），每完成若干核心樓層即核對樁頭沉陷與插入柱應變，並以施工階段分析確認擋土牆與樓板支撐在每一開挖階段的內力；達到允許的核心高度前，筏基須完成並驗收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before concreting, survey plunge-column position and verticality, commonly within 1/400 of length; after every few core storeys check pile-head settlement and plunge-column strain, and use construction-stage analysis to confirm retaining-wall and slab-prop forces at each excavation stage; the raft must be complete and accepted before the core exceeds its permitted height.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With 8 plunge-column piles under the core and 3,000 kN of core load per storey, the core can rise at most about 8×7,070/3,000 ≈ 18 storeys before the raft is complete. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug", which statement holds?
options: 倫敦黏土中鑽掘樁側摩擦 Q_s = πDLαc_u。
只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。
所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。

quiz.explanation: 倫敦黏土中鑽掘樁側摩擦 Q_s = πDLαc_u。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Side friction of a bored pile in London Clay is Q_s = πDLαc_u. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「由上而下的核心筒」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Top-down core” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 插入柱的位置與垂直度在澆置前以測量確認（常見允差為長度的 1/400 以內），每完成若干核心樓層即核對樁頭沉陷與插入柱應變，並以施工階段分析確認擋土牆與樓板支撐在每一開挖階段的內力；達到允許的核心高度前，筏基須完成並驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before concreting, survey plunge-column position and verticality, commonly within 1/400 of length; after every few core storeys check pile-head settlement and plunge-column strain, and use construction-stage analysis to confirm retaining-wall and slab-prop forces at each excavation stage; the raft must be complete and accepted before the core exceeds its permitted height. steps.instruction: 公開資料指出工程共使用五部塔吊，其中四部隨塔樓「跳升」，並有英國首部架在滑模頂上的塔吊；塔頂 66 m、約 500 公噸的尖塔由約 800 件玻璃與鋼構件組成，最後一部塔吊專為安裝上部尖塔而架設。爬升塔吊把垂直荷重與傾覆力矩透過兩道以上的支承框傳給核心牆，因此核心牆在支承位置的混凝土齡期、強度與局部承壓都要檢核；塔樓收分到頂部時空間狹小，尖塔構件的分段重量與吊裝順序決定了塔吊選型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「跳升塔吊與 66 m 尖塔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

A climbing crane transfers vertical load and overturning moment to the core walls through two or more support collars, so concrete age, strength and local bearing at the collar locations must be checked; as the tower tapers to the top, space becomes tight and the weight and sequence of spire pieces drive crane selection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Jumping cranes and the 66 m spire” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 爬升塔吊與塔頂尖塔施工：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跳升塔吊與 66 m 尖塔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：塔吊傾覆力矩由上下兩道支承框以水平力偶傳給核心：H = M/s。M = 6,000 kN·m、支承框間距 s = 10 m：H = 600 kN；若間距只能做到 6 m，H = 1,000 kN，核心牆在支承處的局部承壓與錨栓拉拔需求增加約 67%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A climbing crane passes its overturning moment to the core as a horizontal couple at two collars: H = M/s. With M = 6,000 kN·m and a collar spacing s = 10 m, H = 600 kN; if only 6 m spacing is possible, H = 1,000 kN, raising local bearing and anchor pull-out demand on the core walls by about 67%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次跳升前由塔吊廠商與結構工程師確認支承處混凝土強度（現場試體或成熟度）、錨栓與支承框安裝，並檢查新支承位置的牆體開口與配筋；尖塔吊裝前核對每件重量、吊點與吊車半徑荷重，並記錄風速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each jump, the crane supplier and structural engineer confirm concrete strength at the supports from field specimens or maturity, anchors and collar installation, and check wall openings and reinforcement at the new support level; before spire lifts verify every piece's weight, lifting points and the radius load chart, and log wind speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.titleEn: Climbing cranes and spire construction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跳升塔吊與 66 m 尖塔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Jumping cranes and the 66 m spire” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次跳升前由塔吊廠商與結構工程師確認支承處混凝土強度（現場試體或成熟度）、錨栓與支承框安裝，並檢查新支承位置的牆體開口與配筋；尖塔吊裝前核對每件重量、吊點與吊車半徑荷重，並記錄風速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each jump, the crane supplier and structural engineer confirm concrete strength at the supports from field specimens or maturity, anchors and collar installation, and check wall openings and reinforcement at the new support level; before spire lifts verify every piece's weight, lifting points and the radius load chart, and log wind speed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塔吊跳升屬高風險作業，須有廠商與結構工程師共同核准的跳升程序、強度停留點與停止風速，由合格的塔吊主管指揮；核心牆的支承預埋件在設計圖中先行標示。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Crane jumping is high risk and needs a procedure approved jointly by the supplier and the structural engineer, with strength hold points and stop wind speeds, directed by a qualified crane supervisor; support embeds in the core walls should be shown on the design drawings in advance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在混凝土強度不足時跳升，支承處可能局部壓碎或錨栓拔出，塔吊傾斜甚至倒塌；尖塔構件吊裝順序不當，會讓已安裝的部分在完成斜撐前承受過大的風力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Jumping before the concrete is strong enough can crush the wall locally or pull out anchors, tilting or even toppling the crane; a poor spire erection sequence can expose partly installed elements to excessive wind before their bracing is complete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 爬升塔吊與塔頂尖塔施工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Climbing cranes and spire construction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跳升塔吊與 66 m 尖塔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Jumping cranes and the 66 m spire” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在混凝土強度不足時跳升，支承處可能局部壓碎或錨栓拔出，塔吊傾斜甚至倒塌；尖塔構件吊裝順序不當，會讓已安裝的部分在完成斜撐前承受過大的風力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Jumping before the concrete is strong enough can crush the wall locally or pull out anchors, tilting or even toppling the crane; a poor spire erection sequence can expose partly installed elements to excessive wind before their bracing is complete. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：爬升塔吊把垂直荷重與傾覆力矩透過兩道以上的支承框傳給核心牆，因此核心牆在支承位置的混凝土齡期、強度與局部承壓都要檢核；塔樓收分到頂部時空間狹小，尖塔構件的分段重量與吊裝順序決定了塔吊選型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A climbing crane transfers vertical load and overturning moment to the core walls through two or more support collars, so concrete age, strength and local bearing at the collar locations must be checked; as the tower tapers to the top, space becomes tight and the weight and sequence of spire pieces drive crane selection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔吊的荷重只由塔吊自身的基礎承擔，與主結構無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「爬升塔吊與塔頂尖塔施工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Climbing cranes and spire construction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若在混凝土強度不足時跳升，支承處可能局部壓碎或錨栓拔出，塔吊傾斜甚至倒塌；尖塔構件吊裝順序不當，會讓已安裝的部分在完成斜撐前承受過大的風力。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「風洞試驗與居住舒適度」與「開挖引起的地層位移與監測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wind-tunnel testing and occupant comfort" and "Excavation-induced ground movement and monitoring": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與居住舒適度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and occupant comfort: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「高頻力平衡風洞試驗」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-frequency force-balance test” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計團隊以三維有限元素與動力分析求出頻率與振型，並委託 RWDI 做高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗，估算風致加速度以檢核居住舒適度；另以補充試驗設計塔頂散熱器與帷幕牆桁架。官方資料指出大樓設計在 50 年回歸期風況下擺動約 300 至 400 mm。住宅與飯店的舒適度要求比辦公嚴格，因為人在家中與夜間對擺動較敏感，所以上部住宅層的加速度是控制條件之一。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「高頻力平衡風洞試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The design team derived frequencies and mode shapes with three-dimensional finite-element and dynamic analysis and commissioned RWDI to run high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel tests estimating wind-induced acceleration for occupant comfort; further tests informed the design of the crown radiator and cladding trusses. Official sources state the building is designed to sway about 300 to 400 mm in winds expected once every 50 years. Comfort criteria for homes and hotels are stricter than for offices because people at home and at night are more sensitive to motion, so accelerations at the upper residential floors are one of the controlling conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “High-frequency force-balance test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：共振分量加速度 a = (2πf)²·x。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The resonant acceleration is a = (2πf)²·x.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大樓擺動 300 至 400 mm 就表示結構有安全疑慮。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tower swaying 300 to 400 mm means it is structurally unsafe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「高頻力平衡風洞試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “High-frequency force-balance test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風洞試驗與居住舒適度
knowledge.text: 設計團隊以三維有限元素與動力分析求出頻率與振型，並委託 RWDI 做高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗，估算風致加速度以檢核居住舒適度；另以補充試驗設計塔頂散熱器與帷幕牆桁架。官方資料指出大樓設計在 50 年回歸期風況下擺動約 300 至 400 mm。
knowledge.textEn: The design team derived frequencies and mode shapes with three-dimensional finite-element and dynamic analysis and commissioned RWDI to run high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel tests estimating wind-induced acceleration for occupant comfort; further tests informed the design of the crown radiator and cladding trusses. Official sources state the building is designed to sway about 300 to 400 mm in winds expected once every 50 years.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：大樓擺動 300 至 400 mm 就表示結構有安全疑慮。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tower swaying 300 to 400 mm means it is structurally unsafe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「風洞試驗與居住舒適度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind-tunnel testing and occupant comfort" is correct?
options: 大樓擺動 300 至 400 mm 就表示結構有安全疑慮。
設計團隊以三維有限元素與動力分析求出頻率與振型，並委託 RWDI 做高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗，估算風致加速度以檢核居住舒適度。
只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。
optionsEn: A tower swaying 300 to 400 mm means it is structurally unsafe.

If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets.

quiz.explanationEn: The design team derived frequencies and mode shapes with three-dimensional finite-element and dynamic analysis and commissioned RWDI to run high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel tests estimating wind-induced acceleration for occupant comfort; further tests informed the design of the crown radiator and cladding trusses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與居住舒適度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and occupant comfort: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高頻力平衡風洞試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-frequency force-balance test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：共振分量加速度 a = (2πf)²·x。f = 0.2 Hz、動態振幅 x = 30 mm：a = (2π×0.2)²×0.030 ≈ 0.0474 m/s² ≈ 4.8 milli-g。常用的 10 年回歸期準則約為住宅 5–7 milli-g、辦公 9–12 milli-g；若振幅增為 45 mm，a ≈ 7.2 milli-g，已接近住宅上限。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The resonant acceleration is a = (2πf)²·x. With f = 0.2 Hz and a dynamic amplitude x = 30 mm, a = (2π×0.2)²×0.030 ≈ 0.0474 m/s² ≈ 4.8 milli-g. Common 10-year criteria are about 5–7 milli-g for residential and 9–12 milli-g for offices; an amplitude of 45 mm gives a ≈ 7.2 milli-g, near the residential upper limit. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：審查風洞報告的模態輸入（頻率、振型、廣義質量、阻尼假設）是否與最新結構模型一致，並針對住宅最高樓層與角落位置列出各回歸期的尖峰加速度；完工後以加速度計實測頻率與阻尼，回頭更新預測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check that the modal inputs in the wind-tunnel report, namely frequencies, mode shapes, generalised masses and damping, match the latest structural model, and list peak accelerations by return period for the highest residential floor and corner positions; after completion measure frequency and damping with accelerometers and update the prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 共振分量加速度 a = (2πf)²·x。f = 0.2 Hz、動態振幅 x = 30 mm：a = (2π×0.2)²×0.030 ≈ 0.0474 m/s² ≈ 4.8 milli-g。常用的 10 年回歸期準則約為住宅 5–7 milli-g、辦公 9–12 milli-g；若振幅增為 45 mm，a ≈ 7.2 milli-g，已接近住宅上限。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The resonant acceleration is a = (2πf)²·x. With f = 0.2 Hz and a dynamic amplitude x = 30 mm, a = (2π×0.2)²×0.030 ≈ 0.0474 m/s² ≈ 4.8 milli-g. Common 10-year criteria are about 5–7 milli-g for residential and 9–12 milli-g for offices; an amplitude of 45 mm gives a ≈ 7.2 milli-g, near the residential upper limit. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風洞試驗與居住舒適度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 風洞試驗與居住舒適度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and occupant comfort: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高頻力平衡風洞試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High-frequency force-balance test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 審查風洞報告的模態輸入（頻率、振型、廣義質量、阻尼假設）是否與最新結構模型一致，並針對住宅最高樓層與角落位置列出各回歸期的尖峰加速度；完工後以加速度計實測頻率與阻尼，回頭更新預測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check that the modal inputs in the wind-tunnel report, namely frequencies, mode shapes, generalised masses and damping, match the latest structural model, and list peak accelerations by return period for the highest residential floor and corner positions; after completion measure frequency and damping with accelerometers and update the prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風洞試驗應在結構模型凍結後再以最終模態參數更新一次，報告須同時列出有無補充阻尼的加速度；若不設阻尼器，須在頂部預留未來加裝的空間與承載作為保險。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Update the wind-tunnel predictions with final modal parameters once the structural model is frozen, list accelerations with and without supplementary damping, and if no damper is installed reserve space and capacity at the top as insurance for a future one.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若結構頻率或阻尼與風洞假設不符（例如混凝土實際模數較低），實際加速度可能高於預測，住戶在強風夜晚感到不適，而事後加裝阻尼器在已完工的高價住宅層中極為困難。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If structural frequency or damping differs from the wind-tunnel assumption, for example because the real concrete modulus is lower, actual acceleration can exceed predictions and residents feel unwell on windy nights, while retrofitting a damper into finished high-value residential floors is extremely difficult. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 若結構頻率或阻尼與風洞假設不符（例如混凝土實際模數較低），實際加速度可能高於預測，住戶在強風夜晚感到不適，而事後加裝阻尼器在已完工的高價住宅層中極為困難。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tower swaying 300 to 400 mm means it is structurally unsafe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 開挖引起的地層位移與監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Excavation-induced ground movement and monitoring: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鄰近鐵路設施位移監測」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Movement monitoring of adjacent rail assets” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大樓緊鄰倫敦橋車站與地下鐵設施，基地上還留有舊建築的樁與擴底。設計者以有限元素分析預測開挖對鄰近基礎設施的位移在可接受範圍，並規劃施工期監測；新樁盡量布置在既有樁與擴底之間。由上而下施工讓樓板在開挖時即提供剛性支撐，減少擋土牆變形與背後地表沉陷。監測的目的是在位移發展到影響軌道、隧道或車站結構前提出警訊，讓施工方法能及時調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鄰近鐵路設施位移監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The building sits beside London Bridge station and Underground assets, and old piles and under-reams remained on the site. The designers used finite-element analysis to predict that movements of adjacent infrastructure would stay within acceptable limits and planned monitoring during construction, and new piles were placed between existing piles and under-reams where possible. Top-down construction lets slabs prop the wall stiffly during excavation, reducing wall deflection and ground settlement behind it. Monitoring exists to warn before movements affect tracks, tunnels or station structures, so methods can be adjusted in time. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Movement monitoring of adjacent rail assets” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以經驗關係估算：擋土牆最大水平位移 δ_h ≈ 0.15%H，背後最大沉陷 δ_v ≈ 0.75δ_h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Empirical estimates give a maximum wall deflection δ_h ≈ 0.15%H and maximum settlement behind it δ_v ≈ 0.75δ_h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鄰近鐵路設施位移監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Movement monitoring of adjacent rail assets”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 開挖引起的地層位移與監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Excavation-induced ground movement and monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鄰近鐵路設施位移監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Movement monitoring of adjacent rail assets” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以經驗關係估算：擋土牆最大水平位移 δ_h ≈ 0.15%H，背後最大沉陷 δ_v ≈ 0.75δ_h。開挖深 H = 15 m：δ_h ≈ 22.5 mm、δ_v ≈ 16.9 mm；若以預測值 70% 作為黃色警戒，δ_v 約 11.8 mm 時即應檢討。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Empirical estimates give a maximum wall deflection δ_h ≈ 0.15%H and maximum settlement behind it δ_v ≈ 0.75δ_h. For an excavation depth H = 15 m, δ_h ≈ 22.5 mm and δ_v ≈ 16.9 mm; with an amber trigger at 70% of the prediction, review should start when δ_v reaches about 11.8 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在擋土牆內設置傾斜管，在鄰近軌道、隧道與車站結構設置稜鏡與自動全站儀，於開挖前取得基準值；每個開挖階段比較實測與預測，達到黃色或紅色警戒值時依預定的應變計畫增加支撐或暫停開挖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install inclinometers in the retaining wall and prisms with automated total stations on adjacent tracks, tunnels and station structures, taking baselines before excavation; compare measured and predicted movement at every excavation stage and, at amber or red triggers, add props or pause excavation under the pre-agreed contingency plan.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 在擋土牆內設置傾斜管，在鄰近軌道、隧道與車站結構設置稜鏡與自動全站儀，於開挖前取得基準值；每個開挖階段比較實測與預測，達到黃色或紅色警戒值時依預定的應變計畫增加支撐或暫停開挖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 帷幕牆接縫的位移容量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 官方資料指出外牆約有 11,000 片玻璃，傾斜的玻璃「碎片」在塔頂延伸並以 25 mm 拉桿斜撐的垂直桁架穩定。帷幕牆單元必須同時容納多種位移：層間變位造成的面內錯動、鋁框溫度伸縮、樓板邊緣撓度與柱的長期縮短。接縫若只按其中一項設計，在其他位移疊加時會被擠壓或拉開，密封膠疲勞後漏水漏氣。傾斜立面使雨水與日照條件更嚴苛，接縫的耐久與可更換性更為重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Official sources state the façade has about 11,000 glass panels, and the tilted glass shards extending above the roof are stabilised by vertical trusses braced with 25 mm rods. Curtain-wall units must accommodate several movements at once: in-plane racking from storey drift, thermal movement of aluminium frames, slab-edge deflection and long-term column shortening. A joint designed for only one of these is crushed or opened when the others add up, and the sealant fatigues until water and air leak. Inclined façades make rain and sun exposure harsher, so joint durability and replaceability matter even more. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鋁豎框熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm；層間變位 h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm（面內錯動）；水平堆疊接縫需容納熱伸縮 5.5 mm 加樓板邊緣撓度 10 mm，約 15.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement of an aluminium mullion is ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm; storey drift of h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm gives in-plane racking; the horizontal stack joint must absorb 5.5 mm of thermal movement plus 10 mm of slab-edge deflection, about 15.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「帷幕牆只需要承受風壓，不必考慮結構變位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A curtain wall only needs to resist wind pressure, not structural movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 帷幕牆接縫的位移容量：定量估算
