steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鋁豎框熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm；層間變位 h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm（面內錯動）；水平堆疊接縫需容納熱伸縮 5.5 mm 加樓板邊緣撓度 10 mm，約 15.5 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement of an aluminium mullion is ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm; storey drift of h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm gives in-plane racking; the horizontal stack joint must absorb 5.5 mm of thermal movement plus 10 mm of slab-edge deflection, about 15.5 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實尺寸樣品做帷幕牆性能試驗（氣密、水密、風壓與層間位移試驗，例如依 ASTM E283、E331、E330 與 AAMA 501），確認接縫在設計位移組合下不失效；安裝時抽查接縫寬度與單元水平，營運後定期檢查密封膠與排水孔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run full-size mock-up tests for air, water, structural pressure and inter-storey movement, for example to ASTM E283, E331, E330 and AAMA 501, confirming joints survive the design movement combination; during installation spot-check joint widths and unit levels, and in service periodically inspect sealant and drainage holes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.explanation: 鋁豎框熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm；層間變位 h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm（面內錯動）；水平堆疊接縫需容納熱伸縮 5.5 mm 加樓板邊緣撓度 10 mm，約 15.5 mm。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 帷幕牆接縫的位移容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實尺寸樣品做帷幕牆性能試驗（氣密、水密、風壓與層間位移試驗，例如依 ASTM E283、E331、E330 與 AAMA 501），確認接縫在設計位移組合下不失效；安裝時抽查接縫寬度與單元水平，營運後定期檢查密封膠與排水孔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run full-size mock-up tests for air, water, structural pressure and inter-storey movement, for example to ASTM E283, E331, E330 and AAMA 501, confirming joints survive the design movement combination; during installation spot-check joint widths and unit levels, and in service periodically inspect sealant and drainage holes. steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural engineer should give the façade consultant written values of storey drift, slab-edge deflection and long-term shortening for every level for inclusion in the façade specification; handover should include glass and sealant replacement procedures and operating limits for the building maintenance unit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 帷幕牆接縫的位移容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack; aged sealant lets rain run into the inclined façade, causing interior leaks and corrosion of anchors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：傾斜立面使雨水與日照條件更嚴苛，接縫的耐久與可更換性更為重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inclined façades make rain and sun exposure harsher, so joint durability and replaceability matter even more.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「帷幕牆只需要承受風壓，不必考慮結構變位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A curtain wall only needs to resist wind pressure, not structural movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「未防火被覆的帽桁架」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unprotected hat trusses” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。這是一個需要被記錄的工程判斷：火災時鋼材高溫後勁度下降，帽桁架對側向勁度的貢獻減少，但結構強度仍由核心筒保證。若未來有人不知道這個前提，可能把帽桁架當成承載構件加以利用（例如懸吊設備或改造時依賴其強度），就會破壞原本的防火策略。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「未防火被覆的帽桁架」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected. That is an engineering judgement that must be documented: in a fire, heated steel loses stiffness and the hat trusses contribute less lateral stiffness, while strength is still assured by the core. If future users are unaware of this premise and start relying on the hat trusses, for example to hang equipment or as strength members in a renovation, the original fire strategy is undermined. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Unprotected hat trusses” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「未防火被覆的帽桁架」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Unprotected hat trusses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses
knowledge.text: 設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。這是一個需要被記錄的工程判斷：火災時鋼材高溫後勁度下降，帽桁架對側向勁度的貢獻減少，但結構強度仍由核心筒保證。

That is an engineering judgement that must be documented: in a fire, heated steel loses stiffness and the hat trusses contribute less lateral stiffness, while strength is still assured by the core.

knowledge.text: 誤解：所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses" is correct?

quiz.explanationEn: The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「未防火被覆的帽桁架」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unprotected hat trusses” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。若帽桁架提供 25% 的側向勁度，火災時整體勁度約為 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83，頂部變位放大約 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 倍。數值為教學假設，僅示範勁度降低而非強度設計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C. If the hat trusses provide 25% of lateral stiffness, the overall stiffness in a fire is about 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83, increasing top drift by about 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 times. Values are teaching assumptions illustrating stiffness loss, not strength design. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告；交接時在現場與竣工圖上標示這些構件為「使用性構件、未防火被覆」，定期巡檢時確認沒有新增附掛荷載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report; at handover label these members on site and on as-built drawings as serviceability members without fire protection, and confirm at periodic inspections that no new loads have been hung from them.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

If the hat trusses provide 25% of lateral stiffness, the overall stiffness in a fire is about 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83, increasing top drift by about 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 times. quiz.question: 依「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses", which statement holds?

Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「未防火被覆的帽桁架」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unprotected hat trusses” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告；交接時在現場與竣工圖上標示這些構件為「使用性構件、未防火被覆」，定期巡檢時確認沒有新增附掛荷載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report; at handover label these members on site and on as-built drawings as serviceability members without fire protection, and confirm at periodic inspections that no new loads have been hung from them. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：防火策略中的「不需被覆」判斷必須附上結構依據、適用條件與禁止事項，納入交接文件與物業管理規章；任何在這些構件上的新增荷載或焊接都需結構與消防工程師共同核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Any no-protection decision in the fire strategy must carry its structural justification, conditions of validity and prohibitions, written into handover documents and building rules; any new load or welding on these members needs joint approval by structural and fire engineers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「未防火被覆的帽桁架」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unprotected hat trusses” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若未來有人不知道這個前提，可能把帽桁架當成承載構件加以利用（例如懸吊設備或改造時依賴其強度），就會破壞原本的防火策略。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If future users are unaware of this premise and start relying on the hat trusses, for example to hang equipment or as strength members in a renovation, the original fire strategy is undermined.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。
